chronological_research.reason: Requires four independent held-out seasons, clustered uncertainty, and all V4 release gates

feature_policy.used: lagged completed non-2020 FBS results only; no held-out/current-season outcomes in features

limitations: Chronological ordering alone does not prove historical publication cutoffs
No proxy/replay score is an authentic historical challenger prediction or production improvement
Only the retained 65-game incumbent cohort has independently verified publication evidence
Prospective experimental performance requires games to finish and independent publication/final-outcome checks

blockers: Four true historical incumbent-paired seasons lack season-specific incumbent priors
Historical original feature-publication timestamps are not independently established
The four-season comparison is a reference proxy, not the incumbent promotion cohort

protocol.authentic_baseline: retained 65-game published 2026 incumbent cohort, reported separately
protocol.challenger: L2 logistic regression over lagged completed non-2020 FBS results; no recruiting, roster or coaching features admitted without historical cutoff evidence
protocol.cohort: independently corroborated FBS-FBS exact-score games with complete paired features; exclude the three retained score disputes and 2020
protocol.feature_window: Most recent three completed non-2020 seasons before target season; at least two observed seasons; no zero-imputed missing history

fitting.tuning: none; report all four primary folds

known_pretest_eligibility_failures: season-specific historical incumbent priors unavailable; proxy reference cannot satisfy incumbent gate
protocol.prospective_research: freeze experimental candidate and incumbent probabilities only for games with scheduled kickoff after issuance; retain exact model/input and independent GitHub publication evidence; never replace production predictions
protocol.reference: prior-results logistic reference proxy, NOT the released incumbent engine
protocol.revision_reason: Availability review before any challenger fit: exclude context families with unverified historical cutoffs; use lagged completed non-2020 results only
protocol.training: expanding seasons 2017..year-1; exclude 2020; no held-out tuning
